'''Iodana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], selling combat gear during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Iodana first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP Ranked Gear Vendor for the [[Jedi Consular]] class. Iodana's appearance and gear was changed with the release of Game Update 2.0, when the elder game gear system was overhauled. She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
